Firms_Domain_AutoJoin_Enabled_Descriptio: Let a firm owner claim their firm's email domain. Once the claim is verified by email, anyone who signs up with an address at that domain joins the firm automatically on their next login. Public mailbox providers (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo and the like) can never be claimed, and each domain belongs to at most one firm. Requires self-serve firms.
Firm_Domains_Description: Everyone who signs up with an address at a verified domain joins this firm automatically.
Firm_Domain_Verification_Email_Placehold: An address at the domain you are claiming
Firm_Domain_Verification_Sent: We sent a confirmation link to __email__. The domain starts working once that link is used.
Firm_Domain_Remove_Confirm: Release __domain__? New signups at that domain will stop joining this firm. People who already joined stay members.
Firm_Domain_Confirmed: Domain confirmed. New signups at this domain will now join the firm.
Firm_Invites_Description: Anyone with one of these links can join this firm until it expires or runs out of uses.
Firm_Invite_Revoke_Confirm: Revoke this link? Anyone still holding it will not be able to join. People who already joined stay members.
error-invalid-domain: That is not a valid email domain.
error-public-email-domain: That is a public email provider and cannot be claimed by a firm. Invite those teammates with an invite link instead.
error-domain-already-claimed: That domain has already been claimed on this workspace.
error-domain-already-verified: That domain is already verified for your firm.
error-domain-not-found: No such domain claim for your firm.
error-verification-email-required: Provide an email address at that domain to send the verification link to.
error-verification-email-domain-mismatch: The verification address must be at the domain you are claiming.
error-invalid-invite-days: Invite links can expire in 1, 7, 15 or 30 days, or never (0).
error-invalid-invite-max-uses: Invite links can allow 1, 5, 10, 25, 50 or 100 uses, or unlimited (0).
error-invite-not-found: No such invite link for your firm.
